facts.current: Trying to spend morning time intentionally reading, catching up on emails, or sitting outside instead of mindlessly scrolling through the phone

plans.text: Make the morning routine more efficient by optimizing the coffee brewing method.
Invest in a milk frother to improve latte-making skills.
Make the morning routine more intentional by using the time to read, catch up on emails, or sit outside instead of scrolling through the phone.
Try the French press method with the darker roast and consider using it to make a stronger coffee concentrate for lattes.
Experiment with different sweeteners in coffee, such as stevia or honey.
Try a new herbal tea that may help with sleep and unwinding before bed.

preferences.text: Does not like the aftertaste of stevia in coffee.
